facts.claim: Virtual characters and environments are a valuable assistive, educational and therapeutic tool for high-functioning autism to implement real-time social interaction.
facts.quote: Finally, we argue that VCs and environments are a valuable assistive, educational and therapeutic tool for HFA.

facts.claim: Digital communication is distinguished from face-to-face communication by a lack of non-verbal cues and time asynchrony.
facts.quote: unique characteristics of digital communication—such as lacking non-verbal cues or time asynchrony—clearly distinguish this new form of communication from traditional face-to-face communication.

facts.claim: Social Virtual Reality is a communication medium that includes non-verbal interaction and avatar communication.
facts.quote: The thematic synthesis reveals five primary domains shaping Social VR development: avatar communication, non-verbal interaction, virtual collaboration, ethical considerations, and inclusivity.

research.angle: While digital communication lacks the non-verbal cues found in face-to-face interaction and may compromise the understanding of emotions, virtual environments also offer specific domains for non-verbal interaction and therapeutic tools for social training.
research.verdict: The evidence confirms that digital communication lacks real-time non-verbal cues which can hinder emotional understanding, but it also shows that technology is being developed to simulate or facilitate these interactions.
research.caveat: The sources provide a mix of literature reviews and theoretical premises rather than experimental data measuring the specific degradation of real-world intuition.
